mvp-poc-local-render/repeatable-local-ru.summary: Why Docker Compose is the repeatable way to run Ask IT locally (api + web + Postgres) before any cloud POC.

sections.heading: Why Docker here
sections.body:
After Labs 4–5 you can run uvicorn and `npm run dev` on your laptop. For a **POC**, mentors and pilots need the **same** stack without installing Python/Node versions by hand. **Docker Compose** starts three containers from one command: API, React UI, and Postgres.

You will **prompt** the AI to generate `backend/Dockerfile`, `frontend/Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, and `DOCKER.md`, then run `docker compose up --build` locally.

sections.heading: What “good” looks like
sections.body:
- `docker run hello-world` succeeds (Docker Desktop engine running).
- `docker compose config` validates with no errors.
- Browser opens the chat UI; `curl http://localhost:8000/health` returns `{"status":"ok"}`.
- Inside compose, the API uses host **`postgres`** in `DATABASE_URL`, not `localhost`.

sections.heading: Where the hands-on lab lives
sections.body: Open **Lab 6: Docker local deployment** in this stage. Expand the **🛠 Lab** panel for step-by-step AI prompts (verify Docker → Dockerfiles + compose → smoke test) and troubleshooting fix prompts.

mvp-poc-local-render/render-poc-deployme.summary: Deploy Ask IT to Render for a public POC URL after Docker works locally.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
Render hosts your API and static web app in the cloud. You will prompt `render.yaml`, env vars, and a deploy checklist—same **prompt → check → fix** loop as Docker.

Prerequisite: **Lab 6 Docker local deployment** so you know the services and health check paths.

sections.heading: Checklist topics
sections.body:
- Service configuration (web + API)
- Build/start commands
- Environment variables (no secrets in Git)
- Logs and deployment smoke test on the public URL

sections.heading: Prompts
sections.body: This read includes a **🛠 Lab** panel below with AI prompts for POC `render.yaml` and troubleshooting (build failures, wrong API URL in the built React app, health check).

mvp-poc-local-render/lab-6-poc-hardening.summary: Hands-on: prompt Dockerfiles and docker-compose for Ask IT, run the full stack locally, and pass smoke tests.

sections.heading: Before you open the lab panel
sections.body: Complete **Environment setup** (Stage 1) so Docker Desktop is installed. Finish **Development** Labs 4–5 so you have a backend and React chat to containerize.

sections.heading: This lab covers
sections.body:
1. Verify Docker (`hello-world`).
2. Prompt-generate Docker POC files (Dockerfiles, compose, `.env.example`, `DOCKER.md`).
3. Run `docker compose up --build` and a bash smoke script.

Expand **🛠 Lab** below for copy-paste prompts and acceptance criteria.

sections.heading: Done when
sections.body: `docker-compose.yml` and `DOCKER.md` exist; compose starts api + web + postgres; smoke tests pass; you used at least one troubleshooting fix prompt if something broke.
